message.content: In one of the interactions, Wolfgang Schulz suggested adding sound-insulating pads to the basement to enhance the acoustics and ensure the sessions were enjoyable for everyone. He also mentioned that they needed to save the full rehearsals for Sunday night to prepare adequately. Wolfgang Schulz emphasized the importance of having a dedicated space for music practice and expressed his enthusiasm for future jam sessions. His suggestions highlighted the significance of a suitable environment for musical practices, which included ensuring the space was conducive to good sound quality and providing a dedicated area for rehearsals.
